events.label: Footsteps
events.played: The plain footstep. Any ground type that has no sound of its own falls back to this one, so it is never silent.

events.label: Footsteps: grass
events.played: Steps on grass and meadow. Crouch is quieter and duller, running is louder and quicker.

events.label: Footsteps: forest floor
events.played: Steps on leaves, needles and forest floor. Crouch is quieter and duller, running is louder and quicker.

events.label: Footsteps: dirt
events.played: Steps on bare dirt, mud and clay. Crouch is quieter and duller, running is louder and quicker.

events.label: Footsteps: gravel
events.played: Steps on gravel and small stones. Crouch is quieter and duller, running is louder and quicker.

events.label: Footsteps: sand
events.played: Steps on sand. Crouch is quieter and duller, running is louder and quicker.

events.label: Footsteps: rock
events.played: Steps on bare rock and stone. Crouch is quieter and duller, running is louder and quicker.

events.label: Footsteps: asphalt
events.played: Steps on roads, concrete and asphalt. Crouch is quieter and duller, running is louder and quicker.

events.label: Gunshot
events.played: A pistol or debug-weapon shot. The shooter hears it flat, everyone else hears it from the muzzle.

events.label: Gunshot, far away
events.played: A gunshot heard from more than 35 meters away: a dull crack with an echo. Closer shots use the Gunshot event.

events.label: Bullet hits the world
events.played: A bullet lands in the ground, a wall or a tree. Shots that fly out of range make no sound.

events.label: Bullet hits a body
events.played: A bullet damages a hog or another player. Heard by everyone near the target.

events.label: Getting hurt
events.played: A player loses health. Own hits play flat, other players are heard where they stand.

events.label: Hog grunt
events.played: A calm hog grunts now and then while it grazes or wanders.

events.label: Hog alert
events.played: A hog notices a player and winds up to charge.

events.label: Hog charge
events.played: A hog charges.

events.label: Hog hurt
events.played: A hog is shot, or stuns itself on a wall.

events.label: Hog dies
events.played: A hog drops dead.

events.label: Crafting starts
events.played: A workbench, campfire or other station begins a job.

events.label: Crafting done
events.played: A station finishes a job and the result lands in its output slot.

sources.name: untamedpixels: 800 Free Game Sound Effects
sources.note: One free ZIP, no account. 48 kHz WAV in category folders: footsteps on grass, wood, sand, snow and gravel, ranged weapons, impacts, human sounds. A LICENSES.txt lists the original sources.

sources.name: OpenGameArt: Hammer, anvil and stonecutter (themightyglider)
sources.note: Small OGG files, no account. Also see Fast Hammer SFX and Stonecutter SFX by the same author.

sources.name: OpenGameArt: Different steps on wood, stone, leaves, gravel and mud
sources.note: One 78 KB ZIP with 8 step sounds, no account.

sources.name: SFXMint: Survival crafting set
sources.note: 17 matching sounds: gravel and snow footsteps, hammer, saw, anvil, forge, crafting, campfire. Anonymous downloads are limited to 2 files a day per network; a free account lifts that and unlocks the whole-pack ZIP. The sounds are AI-generated.

sources.name: Kenney: Impact Sounds and RPG Audio
sources.note: Consistent, small packs. Impact Sounds has footsteps on grass, concrete, wood and snow plus body hits. RPG Audio has cloth, metal and item sounds.

sources.name: OpenGameArt: Gunshot Sounds (Tabasco)
sources.license: Page says CC0, bundled text says CC-BY 3.0: credit the author to be safe
sources.note: Real recordings of a CZ-52 pistol, rifle, SKS and shotgun. The author warns they are noisy: trim and normalize them.

sources.name: OpenGameArt: Playersounds 1 (EmoPreben)
sources.note: Four player hurt sounds, WAV and OGG zips.

sources.name: OpenGameArt: Hurt Sound Effects (EZduzziteh)
sources.note: Six pain and grunt vocalizations as small MP3 files.

sources.name: Sonniss GDC Game Audio Bundle
sources.note: Free professional libraries, several GB per year. Use Scan a folder with a filter such as pistol or footstep instead of unpacking everything.

sources.name: Freesound (CC0 filter)
sources.note: Largest library. Needs a free account to download. Filter to CC0 so you owe no credit.
